Moumita Bangal (Adhikary) vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors
on 18 January, 2023
Author: Bibek Chaudhuri

Bench: Bibek Chaudhuri
Form J(1) In The High Court At Calcutta
 Criminal Revisional Jurisdiction
 Appellate Side
Present :
The Hon'ble Justice Bibek Chaudhuri
 Crr 4168 of 2022
 Moumita Bangal (Adhikary)
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Ors.
For the petitioner : Mr. Rafikul Islam Sardar, Adv.
For the State : Mr. Abhisek Sinha, Adv.
Judgement on : 18.01.2023.

Bibek Chaudhuri, J.
This is an application for a direction for expeditious disposal of Misc. Case No. 417/2021 being a proceeding under Section 12(1) of the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate, 3rd Court at Howrah.

entities.text: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It is submitted by the learned Advocate for the petitioner that the petitioner was physically and mentally tortured and thereafter she was compelled to file a case under Sections 498A/34 of the Indian Penal Code.
She has been residing separately from her husband.

In order to maintain herself and her minor son she prayed for interim monetary relief by filing an application on 7 th September,
2021.
An application for interim monetary relief under the Domestic Violence Act is required to be disposed of within three days from the date of filing of the application.
However, the statutory dictum has not been complied with by the learned Judicial Magistrate.
It is further submitted that the husband/opposite party has appeared in the said proceeding and on his prayer the learned Magistrate is granting adjournment one after another.

The instant revision is disposed of directing the learned Magistrate to obtain affidavits of assets from both the parties within one month from the date of communication of this order and thereafter conclude the hearing of the application for interim monetary relief within one month.
